sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.

sources.title: ChatGPT: Chat, Work, Create & Code with AI
sources.snippet: Use ChatGPT to answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code—all in one place. Get started for free or download the app.

sources.title: GPT-4 | OpenAI
sources.snippet: GPT‑4‑assisted safety research GPT‑4's advanced reasoning and instruction-following capabilities expedited our safety work. We used GPT‑4 to help create training data for model fine-tuning and iterate on classifiers across training, evaluations, and monitoring.
